## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Orléans, France. It starts at Château de Chambord.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> So magnificent and unique is Château de Chambord that it's considered the architectural equivalent of the Mona Lisa. Step into the symbolic, aesthetic, and spiritual enigma that is this 16th-century retreat built for François I, with design elements attributed to Leonardo da Vinci.
>
> Surrounded by a fairy tale forest, Château de Chambord is a wonderland packed with half a millennium of French history and unique architectural details like a double-spiral staircase!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €21.88. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 1070 ratings and 428 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
